horizon_row_px.meaning: image row y_h of the horizon in the pinhole ground model
horizon_row_px.note: from 3 tape strips at known distances; residual rms 0.008 m (replaces the width-model horizon)

camera_height_eff_m.meaning: k: effective camera height (height / cos(pitch)), metres
camera_height_eff_m.note: fitted from 651 valid frames (5245 rows, 5228 after clipping); width residual rms 24.2 px; flat ground, no distortion

depth_scale_F.meaning: F = focal length (px) x k: converts rows to forward distance, metre*pixel
depth_scale_F.note: from 3 tape strips at known distances; residual rms 0.008 m

axis_x_ref_px.meaning: image column of the vehicle's forward axis at row `axis_ref_row`

axis_slope.meaning: d(column)/d(row) of the vehicle's forward axis line in the image (0 = vertical)

camera_forward_of_rear_axle_m.meaning: distance from the rear-axle centre forward to the camera lens, metres
camera_forward_of_rear_axle_m.note: ruler: horizontal distance rear-axle centre to camera lens (user measurement 2026-10-21)
